findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_tour · Private data: compare_toured_homes, request_tour, get_renter_brief · Public sink: request_tour.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_tour · Private data: compare_toured_homes, request_tour, get_renter_brief · Public sink: request_tour

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
